body:
Fixes #9526
Clause-②: yes

Two type names join the root entry of `@object-ui/types`: `CommandItem` and `CommandGroup`, the element types of `CommandSchema` (`groups` holds `CommandGroup`; each group's `items` hold `CommandItem`). Both were published on `@object-ui/types/form` only, while `CommandSchema` itself sat on the root barrel's `./form.js` re-export list.

Implemented by the `os-dev` seat dispatched from `domain:ui` seat 1, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`, on the claim at comment 5818314309.

## Governing ruling

The class ruled on objectui#9406 (director seat, decision batch 133, item 2, letter (a), maintainer 2026-09-14): an additive re-export on the root barrel, "additive, no other line moves". The PM's dispatch applies that class ruling to this card and authorises exactly the two names on it; nothing else moves. Precedents on the same list: objectui#7697 (`ComboboxOption`) and objectui#9406 / PR objectui#9525 (`InputShorthandSchema`, `UiCalendarSchema`).

Same-source control: two clean builds of the head source came back byte-identical, so the one-line delta is a reading and not emit noise.

Source: `packages/types/src/index.ts` gains one hunk, 10 insertions and 0 deletions: the two names and a comment saying why they are there. The declarations stay in `form.ts` (fenced by objectui#10292 and not touched).

```
probe-9526.ts(2,15): error TS2305: Module '"@object-ui/types"' has no exported member 'CommandGroup'.
```

⚠️ Measured difference from objectui#9406: here the compiler offers no "Did you mean" suggestion, only a plain TS2305, through the package entry and through the relative `../index` import alike. The case for the change is the asymmetry itself (the schema resolves from the root, the types it contains do not), not a steering suggestion.

1. Both ledger rows removed. Its liveness check would otherwise fail them as stale; with them gone, the derived gap check holds the pair to the list the way it holds every other `form.ts` export.
2. A type-level block for objectui#9526: each root spelling is pinned as the containment the root `CommandSchema` actually carries (the element of `groups` is `CommandGroup`, the element of `items` is `CommandItem`), each root spelling equals its `/form` spelling, and `CommandSchema`'s `type` literal is the lit control.
3. The header's list of instances gains the third one.

Placement: the dispatch asked for a new pin, and the claim's file surface names the barrel, this pin file and one changeset. The type-level block therefore lives in the existing pin file rather than a new test file, so the surface is not breached.
